newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco's Treasury refuses funds for second week.
newsitem.headline: Morocco's Treasury refuses funds for second week.

text.p: Morocco's Treasury raised no funds from its weekly treasury bill auction, Bank al-Maghrib (central bank) said on Thursday.
Moroccan banks offered a total 1.734 billion dirhams, "but the Treasury turned down the offer," a Moroccan official said, but gave no other details.

This is the second week that the Treasury has refused bank offers, which is seen as a move to push local banks to lower interest rates, the official said. Treasury officials were not immediately available for comment.
